findings.detail: Replica initialization uses the complete training embedding set rather than that replica's bootstrap resample. The subsequent optimization loader samples with replacement (lines 309-312), but KMeans initialization is a fit on the unresampled data, so the five replicas do not each fit the specified bootstrap dataset throughout their tokenizer fit. This weakens the key resampling mechanism; it does not introduce validation/test leakage.
findings.reproduction: For any replica_id, trace the input to replica.init_codebook at line 307: it is train_embeddings, whereas the bootstrap indices are not drawn until lines 309-310. Consequently changing the bootstrap RNG/sample while holding train_embeddings fixed leaves the replica's initial codebook fit input unchanged.
findings.correction: Draw the N bootstrap indices before initialization and initialize each replica on replica_data (or an equivalent bootstrap sample), then use that same resampled dataset for replica fitting. Keep assignments evaluated on the common train_embeddings item list for alignment.
